text: std::fs::canonicalize fails on paths that don't exist yet, complicating write-path validation
mitigation: Use resolve_for_create approach: canonicalize nearest existing parent, validate that, construct child path from validated parent

text: Symlink TOCTOU race between validation and operation
mitigation: Accept as inherent filesystem API limitation; document in README security section

text: rmcp crate has protocol incompatibilities with specific MCP clients
mitigation: Test against Claude Desktop and Claude Code before release; pin rmcp version

text: Large directory trees cause timeout on directory_tree or search_files
mitigation: Enforce maxTreeDepth, maxDirectoryEntries, maxSearchResults; use spawn_blocking with timeout wrappers

text: Binary detection for read_text_file fails on extensionless binary files (Mach-O, ELF)
mitigation: Add magic byte detection as fallback; document that extensionless binary files may be misidentified

mitigation: Most-specific-wins is deterministic and documented; include examples in README

text: edit_file pattern matching fails on files with mixed line endings (CRLF vs LF)
